name: mirage
text: Got all four: (1) chat draft kept when you switch tabs/apps, (2) 'Kalshi' instead of 'Novig' on the Kalshi bet slips, (3) the Kalshi slip closes right after Bet like Novig's, (4) notifications for Kalshi bets placed, bids filled, and failed/timed-out orders. Building them into the same release as the API status fix.
